scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: When he says money, what does he mean?

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Ethan's father left a portion of his wealth for him. Victor calls it his reward.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: For being near me when something good happened. That is how he counts other people's lives.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: We keep the call record and what you remember. We won't let his word become the name of a real debt.

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
